requirements.title: View Saved Wishlist Items
requirements.clause: When navigating to Wish List in dashboard sidebar or header navbar icon, saved product cards should be displayed with item details and remove actions.

requirements.title: Empty Wishlist State Handling
requirements.clause: When customer has no products in wishlist, page displays 'Your wishlist is empty.' and a 'Browse products ->' button linking to home page (/)

requirements.title: Add Product to Wishlist
requirements.clause: When clicking ♡ Wishlist button on product card or PDP, product is added with bar notification success message and header wishlist count updates.
